sights.address: Toon Lagoon, Universal Islands of Adventure, 6000 Universal Blvd, Orlando, FL
sights.w: 1999 log flume with a 75-foot drop that dips below water level; Orlando Informer ranks it among IOA's three water rides ("a solid ride"); rated 3.5/5 by TouringPlans.

sights.address: Jurassic Park, Universal Islands of Adventure, 6000 Universal Blvd, Orlando, FL
sights.w: Boat ride past animatronic dinosaurs ending in an 85-foot plunge from the T. rex; Orlando Informer ranks it #1 of IOA's water rides; TouringPlans 4/5. NOTE: closed for refurbishment, reopening Nov 20, 2026 (TouringPlans).

sights.w: Original-1999 Dr. Seuss dark ride on spinning couches through the book's story; TouringPlans 3.5/5; a Seuss Landing family staple.

sights.address: Minion Land, Universal Studios Florida, 6000 Universal Blvd, Orlando, FL
sights.w: 2012 3-D motion-simulator ride through Gru's lab, now the anchor of 2023's Minion Land; Theme Park Insider toured the land at opening.

sights.address: Minion Land, Universal Studios Florida, 6000 Universal Blvd, Orlando, FL
sights.w: Interactive moving-walkway blaster ride that opened Aug 11, 2023 as the new headliner of Minion Land (Wikipedia); Theme Park Insider covered the land's debut.

sights.address: DreamWorks Land, Universal Studios Florida, 6000 Universal Blvd, Orlando, FL
